decision: D1: Sales hosts the bill at /dashboard/pharmacy/sales/bill (?draft=<id> or prefill params) under the Sales|Returns header; New sale opens it; the new bill carries the pending-prescription queue with Load
why: a route with URL state survives reload and is deep-linkable without mixing bill state into the register's filter URL

decision: D2: Save draft stores patient, doctor, prescription link, payment method, billing details, notes and every line (product, stock item, qty, price, discount, GST, directions) with no stock or payment; the Draft row reopens it; finishing goes through checkout with draftId and draftVersion so the same record keeps its number, posts stock once and replays safely; finishing also records the bill's payment

decision: D2a: A draft can be saved only when every medicine has a stocked product and a Tax %
why: the server cannot store an unmatched line or a pending GST rate, and storing 0% would reopen a different bill
